RELEASE OF TEMPORARY EXHIBIT

Depositor: ⟦PERSON|Delva Rosk⟧
Exhibition company: ⟦ORG|Cinder Reed Displays Ltd⟧ (the Company)

This page records the return of the demonstration model after the
public exhibition. The model was shown behind a barrier and was not
offered for sale. Its return does not transfer the design rights or
permit the Company to reproduce the internal mechanism.

The large printed signature caption was recognised with spaces
between every letter:

⟦PERSON|D E L V A   R O S K⟧

The depositor authorises collection by ⟦PERSON|Veyra Nemmick⟧. The
collector may sign for the packing case but may not agree that the
surface finish is free from damage before the protective wrap has
been rernoved. Any exception must be recorded on the delivery sheet.

The return fee of GBP 72 includes ordinary packing materials. Additional
crating requires written approval. Clause 6.1 remains applicable to
transport insurance, and the inspection deadline is 22 November 2026.

The enclosed photographs show the model before dismantling. A loose
fastener visible in the second photograph belongs to the temporary
display base and is not part of the deposited object. Please keep it
with the base rather than inserting it into the mechanism.

Contact email: ⟦EMAIL|delva.return@cinder-reed.invalid⟧
